8.  **07:15 AM** – Placed absorbent booms and pads around affected area to control residual water. Floor drying fans (2 units) positioned and turned on.

Water Intrusion Report Form

Form Version: 4.2 (Rev. Jan 2023)
Report No.: WIR-2023-0617
Date of Incident: 06/17/2023
Time of Incident: 05:55 (approx.)
Location: Lower Level – Aisle 2 Bay C, Aisle 3 Bay C, Sump Pit S-1
Building: Collection Storage Wing, Lower Level
Reported By: M. Chen (Facilities Technician II)
Date Submitted: 06/17/2023
Time Submitted: 07:30

SECTION 1 – INCIDENT SUMMARY

At approximately 05:55, water was observed on the floor of Aisle 2 Bay C and Aisle 3 Bay C, Lower Level. Water originated from Sump Pit S-1, which overflowed due to sump pump failure. Pump motor found off; electrical fault identified at breaker panel LP-3. Manual bailing initiated; affected collection boxes moved to staging area. No active leak at time of report. Full chronology in Section 3.

SECTION 2 – CAUSE OF INTRUSION

Primary cause: Sump pump S-1 failed to activate during a period of heavy groundwater infiltration. The pump motor was found in the OFF position at breaker panel LP-3 (circuit labeled "LP-3 – Sump Pump S-1"). A tripped breaker was confirmed at 06:10. The breaker was reset at 06:20 and immediately tripped again, indicating a short or ground fault in the pump circuit. The pump remains off pending electrical troubleshooting.

Contributing factor: The float switch for Sump Pit S-1 was not serviced within the recommended 6-month interval. Last service entry in the Maintenance Log is dated 03/14/2023 (entry M-2023-0147). No service record exists for the float switch specifically. Float switch function could not be verified with pump power off.

Secondary note: A minor pipe leak was reported in this area on 04/22/2023 (see Maintenance Log entry M-2023-0098). That leak was traced to a condensation drip from a chilled water line and was repaired the same day. No connection to current incident. No residual moisture observed from that event during today's inspection.

SECTION 3 – CHRONOLOGY OF EVENTS

All times approximate. Times recorded in local time (EDT). Personnel: M. Chen (Facilities Tech II), D. Okafor (Facilities Tech I), J. Wong (Facilities Director, notified 06:40).

05:55 – Chen on routine patrol of Lower Level. Observed water on floor in Aisle 2 Bay C, extending toward Aisle 3 Bay C. Water depth estimated at 1/8 inch in lowest area. Source traced to Sump Pit S-1, which was overflowing. Water appeared clean; no odor noted at this time.

06:00 – Chen checked Sump Pit S-1. Water level at rim. Pump motor not running. Float switch observed in raised position. Chen attempted to activate pump manually via test switch – no response. Checked breaker panel LP-3. Breaker for Sump Pump S-1 found in tripped position. Chen did not reset at this time; notified Okafor.

06:10 – Okafor arrived with portable pump and bailing equipment. Water level in pit approximately 1 inch above rim. Okafor began bailing into floor drain at Aisle 3 Bay D. Chen called Facilities Director J. Wong – no answer; left voicemail.

06:15 – Chen and Okafor began moving affected boxes from Aisle 2 Bay C to staging area (pallet location P-4, near freight elevator). Boxes in Aisle 2 Bay C: lower shelf row, 14 boxes total. All showed some degree of water staining on bottom edges. No boxes actively dripping.

06:20 – Chen reset breaker at panel LP-3. Breaker held for approximately 30 seconds, then tripped again. No audible or visible arc at panel. Chen left breaker off and placed lockout/tagout tag #F-4412 on panel. Pump remains off.
